title: French-Style Roasted Chicken
description: A classic French dish where chicken is marinated in a mixture of herbs and spices before being roasted to perfection.
instructions: Rinse the chicken and pat dry with paper towels.
In a small bowl, mix together thyme, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Rub the spice mixture all over the chicken, making sure to get some under the skin as well.
Place the chicken in a large roasting pan and drizzle with olive oil.
Stuff the cavity of the chicken with the quartered lemon, sliced onion, and sliced carrots.
Roast the chicken in the preheated oven for 45-50 minutes, or until the internal temperature reaches 165°F (74°C).
Baste the chicken with the pan juices every 20 minutes to keep it moist and golden brown.
Once the chicken is cooked, remove it from the oven and let it rest for 10-15 minutes before carving.
